column1: # Every audio file shipped in game/assets/sound, with its GNU FreeDink source.
# Source set: freedink-data 1.08.20190120 (Sound/). Authors and licenses follow
# licenses/FREEDINK-DATA-COPYRIGHT.txt. Rendered .ogg music is FluidSynth output
# of the FreeDink MIDI named here (tools/import_assets.py render_midi).
# sha256 = shipped file; source_sha256 = the FreeDink file. Checked by
# Rows with freedink_file "-" fill the 27 effects FreeDink leaves silent. They are
# built by tools/build_sfx.py; source_sha256 lists the pinned downloads each was
# built from ("-" = synthesized, our own work), and credit names each source's
